_comment: A card that exists only for the mill-binding and grant-playable test (tests/unit/casting/test_grant_playable.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_locke` is Locke's Mug ability as an ETB rather than an attack trigger, so the sandbox can reach it.

cards.name: Test Locke
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, each player mills a card. If a land card was milled this way, create a Treasure token. Until end of turn, you may cast a spell from among those cards.
